missed.title: Upstream opt-in checks presence rather than value
missed.description: `[[ ! -v NIX_BITCOIN_FETCH_UPSTREAM ]]` permits fetching when the variable is empty or set to 0, despite the documented requirement to set it to 1. Compare its value explicitly with 1 so configurations intended to disable upstream fetching actually refuse it.

summary: Eight reports describe real conditions or coverage gaps, with F3 and FW-5 duplicating one advisory; F2 is false-positive. Prioritize the firewall-backend assertion and legacy signature verification, and correct the incomplete test and cleanup recommendations. Inspection and evaluation were read-only; no VM tests were run.
